components.css: .ds-board { display: grid; width: min(100%, 500px); aspect-ratio: 1; grid-template: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)) / repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--cell-gap); margin: 0 auto; padding: var(--cell-gap); border: 1px solid #233b60; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--navy); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(23, 43, 77, 0.12); touch-action: none; user-select: none; } .ds-row { display: contents; } .ds-cell { display: flex; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #c5d3e4; border-radius: 5px; background: #d6e2f0; color: var(--navy); font-size: clamp(22px, 5.2vw, 48px); font-weight: 760; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1; } .ds-cell[data-value="0"] { border-color: #d8e1ed; background: var(--empty); } .ds-board:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-tile { position: relative; display: flex; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #c5d3e4; border-radius: 5px; background: #d6e2f0; color: var(--navy); font-size: clamp(22px, 5.2vw, 48px); font-weight: 760; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1; transition: background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-tile[data-value="0"] { border-color: #d8e1ed; background: var(--empty); } .ds-tile[data-value="1"], .ds-tile[data-value="2"] { background: #e7edf5; } .ds-tile[data-value="3"], .ds-tile[data-value="4"] { background: #d6e2f0; } .ds-tile[data-value="5"], .ds-tile[data-value="6"] { background: #bfd1e7; } .ds-tile[data-value="7"], .ds-tile[data-value="8"], .ds-tile[data-value="9"], .ds-tile[data-value="10"], .ds-tile[data-value="11"], .ds-tile[data-value="12"], .ds-tile[data-value="13"], .ds-tile[data-value="14"], .ds-tile[data-value="15"], .ds-tile[data-value="16"] { background: #a9c2e0; } .ds-tile.ds-just-merged::after { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: clamp(9px, 2.4vw, 15px); height: clamp(9px, 2.4vw, 15px); border-top: 3px solid var(--coral); border-right: 3px solid var(--coral); content: ""; } .ds-tile.ds-just-merged { animation: ds-prime-build 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @keyframes ds-prime-build { 0% { background: #f3b2a1; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--coral); } 100% { background: #bfd1e7; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0 transparent; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tile { transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; } }

narrative.overview:
Prime Swipe's visual signature is a small, geometric identity mark and a square game matrix. The self-hosted Aldrich face gives the wordmark and lead heading a distinct, grid-conscious voice; the system sans carries actions, rules, feedback, and values so play stays legible.

Cool pale surfaces and deep navy ink frame construction-blue structure. Coral appears as a compact signal for focus and meaningful game states. Geometry belongs to the board and its measured cells rather than to background decoration: the board is the largest control on desktop and leads the stacked layout on narrow screens.
keyCharacteristics: A visible four-by-four construction grid with stable square cells.
Aldrich display lettering paired with a system-sans interface.
Pale blue-white surfaces, navy ink, construction blue, and restrained coral signals.
Responsive, keyboard- and touch-operable game controls with visible focus and reduced motion.

rules.name: The Signal Economy Rule
rules.body: Keep coral attached to a meaningful state, focus, or identity detail; do not turn it into a broad decorative fill.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep Aldrich to the wordmark and lead heading; use the system sans for operating text and game data.

rules.name: The Square-Board Rule
rules.body: Preserve a square, evenly divided 4×4 board as the visual and interaction center at every breakpoint.

rules.name: The Cell Geometry Rule
rules.body: Keep cells equal, square, and clearly separated; corner rounding stays secondary to the measured grid.

dos: **Do** retain the responsive square 4×4 board and its equal cell geometry.
**Do** use the coral outline for keyboard focus and the coral mark for meaningful merge or goal states.
**Do** keep Score, largest-prime Best, and goal status visually distinct; use tabular numerals for game data.
**Do** preserve the system-sans workhorse and the self-hosted Aldrich display roles.
**Do** respect reduced-motion preferences and keep the board usable by touch and keyboard.
donts: **Don't** use coral as a broad decorative color; its role is a compact signal.
**Don't** spread Aldrich across dense rules, controls, and game data.
**Don't** reshape the board or vary cell geometry to create decoration.
**Don't** repeat the existing outlined-board/dialog plus soft-shadow pairing as a new surface recipe; it is source drift, not a depth token.
